sql: UPDATE poller SET requires_sync="on" WHERE id=?

SELECT *
			FROM settings
			WHERE name NOT LIKE "%_lastrun%"
			AND name NOT LIKE "path_%"
			AND name NOT LIKE "%_path"
			AND name NOT LIKE "stats%"
			AND name != "rrdtool_version"
			AND name NOT LIKE "poller_replicate%"
			AND name NOT LIKE "install%"
			AND name != "poller_enabled"
			AND name NOT LIKE "md5dirsum%"
			UNION
			SELECT *
			FROM settings
			WHERE name LIKE "path_spine%"
			AND name="poller_type"

SELECT hsq.*
			FROM host_snmp_query AS hsq
			INNER JOIN host AS h
			ON h.id=hsq.host_id
			WHERE h.poller_id = ?
			AND h.deleted = ""

SELECT pc.*
			FROM poller_command AS pc
			WHERE pc.poller_id = ?

SELECT h.*
			FROM host AS h
			WHERE h.poller_id = ?
			AND h.deleted = ""

SELECT hsc.*
			FROM host_snmp_cache AS hsc
			INNER JOIN host AS h
			ON h.id=hsc.host_id
			WHERE h.poller_id = ?
			AND h.deleted = ""

SELECT pri.*
			FROM poller_reindex AS pri
			INNER JOIN host AS h
			ON h.id=pri.host_id
			WHERE h.poller_id = ?
			AND h.deleted = ""

DELETE pr
			FROM poller_reindex AS pr
			LEFT JOIN host_snmp_query AS hsq
			ON pr.host_id = hsq.host_id
			AND pr.data_query_id = hsq.snmp_query_id
			WHERE hsq.host_id IS NULL

SELECT pi.*
			FROM poller_item AS pi
			WHERE pi.poller_id = ?

UPDATE poller_item
				SET last_updated = FROM_UNIXTIME(?)
				WHERE poller_id = ?

DELETE FROM poller_item
				WHERE last_updated < ?
				AND last_updated > 0
				AND last_updated IS NOT NULL

SELECT dl.*
			FROM data_local AS dl
			INNER JOIN host AS h
			ON h.id=dl.host_id
			WHERE h.poller_id = ?
			AND h.deleted = ""

SELECT gl.*
			FROM graph_local AS gl
			INNER JOIN host AS h
			ON h.id=gl.host_id
			WHERE h.poller_id = ?
			AND h.deleted = ""

SELECT dtd.*
			FROM data_template_data AS dtd
			INNER JOIN data_local AS dl
			ON dtd.local_data_id=dl.id
			INNER JOIN host AS h
			ON h.id=dl.host_id
			WHERE h.poller_id = ?
			AND h.deleted = ""

SELECT dtr.*
			FROM data_template_rrd AS dtr
			INNER JOIN data_local AS dl
			ON dtr.local_data_id=dl.id
			INNER JOIN host AS h
			ON h.id=dl.host_id
			WHERE h.poller_id = ?
			AND h.deleted = ""

SELECT gti.*
			FROM graph_templates_item AS gti
			INNER JOIN graph_local AS gl
			ON gti.local_graph_id=gl.id
			INNER JOIN host AS h
			ON h.id=gl.host_id
			WHERE h.poller_id = ?
			AND h.deleted = ""

SELECT did.*
			FROM data_input_data AS did
			INNER JOIN data_template_data AS dtd
			ON did.data_template_data_id=dtd.id
			INNER JOIN data_local AS dl
			ON dl.id=dtd.local_data_id
			INNER JOIN host AS h
			ON h.id=dl.host_id
			WHERE h.poller_id = ?
			AND h.deleted = ""

SELECT
		SUM(CASE WHEN action=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS snmp,
		SUM(CASE WHEN action=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS script,
		SUM(CASE WHEN action=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS server
		FROM poller_item
		WHERE poller_id = ?

UPDATE poller
			SET snmp = ?, script = ?, server = ?
			WHERE id = ?
UPDATE poller SET last_sync=NOW(), requires_sync="" WHERE id=?
